summary: A multi-line text field, in three shapes, with an optional character counter and error or success states.

props.name: label
props.description: Text above the control. `Field.Root` and `Field.Label` associate it automatically, so no `id`/`htmlFor` bookkeeping is needed.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the control, for format or context. Replaced by `error` or `success` when either is set.
props.example: Shown under the folder name and found by search.

props.name: error
props.description: Red border, a warning icon & this message in place of `description`. Wins over `success` if both are set.

props.name: success
props.description: Green border, a check icon & this message in place of `description`.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Caps the value and draws the counter under the field. Zero draws neither.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`, which degrades to a rounded square where that is unsupported.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the whole field, label included.

props.name: required
props.description: Appends a red asterisk to the label & sets the control's native `required` attribute.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it along with the danger, error and success tints that ride with it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.

props.label: Description
props.description: Shown under the folder name and found by search.
props.defaultValue: Receipts for the 2026 tax return. Scanned from paper, so a few are rotated.
